name: 81006 · Pueblo, CO
findings: ZIP 81006 (Pueblo) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81006 (Pueblo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 81006 (Pueblo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
